status: PRE-COMMITTED: fixed before the first agent run; edits need a new suite id
measures: Agent tool selection over the three deployed MCP servers. The answer text is recorded but not scored.

scoring.pass: every `required` tool is called at least once AND every called tool is in `required` or `allowed`
scoring.called: tool names in call order, taken from the agent run (the SDK's tool-call items), counting MCP and local tools
scoring.argument_checks: each `args` entry names a tool and argument values that at least one call to that tool must carry (integer and case-sensitive string equality; a list value means any one of those alternatives); a missing match fails the scenario
invariants: I1: the agent is never given portal_submit_review_request or portal_submit_review_decision (the gate); checked on every run from the tool list sent to the model
I2: an agent run writes no sandbox rows: the three review tables have the same row counts before and after each agent run

I3 (AES-10, repetition 1 only): the draft is written only after an approval step; that write lands as one sandbox request with created + routed events; cleanup by the pre-registered request_id leaves 0/0/0
scoring.report: per scenario k/5 passes; overall passes/50 with a Wilson 95% interval; tool-call precision and recall against `required`; turns, latency and errors. No pass bar is set: this is a measurement, not a gate. The invariants are hard: any violation is reported as a failure of the gate.
